capabilities: Export highlighted text as flashcards to Mochi
Create cards matching Mochi template format
Batch export multiple cards at once
Render card content with Markdown and LaTeX
Run exports from the command palette
extras: Only works with a paid Mochi Pro subscription; cards must start with the specific Mochi template format shown in the README.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to create flashcards in Mochi from note text, so users must copy content over manually.
summary: Flashcard exporter that sends selected note text to Mochi.cards through Mochi's Pro subscription API.
